before.description: Revisions older than this UTC time are removed. The current values of records stay. It must lie in the past (`400 validation_error`, field `before`, rule `not_in_past`), and a date older than every revision is refused as well (rule `nothing_to_purge`).

collection.description: Purge only this collection. Default: the whole app.

confirm.description: The `token` of the preview of exactly this purge. A purge is always confirmed: without a token, or with one that no longer holds, the answer is `confirmation_required` with the current preview.

description: Removes the history older than a date. The preview answers with a token; send it as `confirm` to purge.
